content: PHP mail() relies on the shared host's local MTA, which is frequently misconfigured/blacklisted, causing high spam-folder or non-delivery rates. PHPMailer (or similar) with authenticated SMTP is the recommended upgrade for reliable delivery, plus SPF/DKIM alignment. Spam mitigation: honeypot hidden field (cheap, no user friction) combined with server-side validation and rate limiting; reCAPTCHA v3 is heavier but optional for a low-traffic local business form.
